gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient must have histologically confirmed newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM, world health organization (WHO) grade IV).

candidate_evidence.quote: A Phase I/II Open Label Study to Assess Safety and Preliminary Evidence of a Therapeutic Effect of Azeliragon Combined With Conventional Concurrent Radiation and Temozolomide

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patient must have histologically confirmed newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM, world health organization (WHO) grade IV).

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Expression levels of the S100A9 molecular biomarker in blood samples from patients. Samples will be taken at baseline, Week 10 and after progression

agents.agent_name_registered: Azeliragon 5 mg; Azeliragon 10 mg; Azeliragon 20 mg

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive azeliragon for up to 2 years or as long as the patient and study investigator feel that a therapeutic benefit is possible.

agents.drug_class_hint: RAGE (receptor for advanced glycation end-products) inhibitor, investigational

role_evidence.quote: plus concomitant daily temozolomide (TMZ; 75 mg/m2/day, 7 days/week from the first to the last day of radiotherapy)

source_quote.quote: Note: Patients should be isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild type diagnosed locally
The local O-6-Methylguanine-DNA Methyltransferase (MGMT) report determination should be available and should be uploaded to the electronic case report form (eCRF).
Expression levels of the S100A9 molecular biomarker in blood samples from patients.

coder_notes: MGMT result must be available at entry but is not a selection criterion (coded exploratory_correlative). S100A9 is a secondary biomarker outcome; the record does not link it to azeliragon or its target, so target_engagement_planned is unclear. Single experimental arm; three azeliragon dose levels collapsed to one agent row.
